title: Guard LiveScreen back navigation with PopScope and handle mid-session BLE disconnects
description: Two UI/BLE lifecycle gaps can leave sessions stuck in Firestore status='recording' with 0 audio: (1) app/lib/ui/live_screen.dart has no PopScope, so an Android system back gesture pops the LiveScreen without calling _stopAndProcess()/stopRecording(). (2) app/lib/services/ble_service.dart and session_manager.dart do not monitor BLE connection state drops during recording, and LiveScreen shows no indicator of received audio packets/bytes. If BLE disconnects or Opus decoding yields 0 bytes (wavBytes.length == 44), stopRecording() skips uploadAudio() (session_manager.dart:223) without updating the backend, leaving the session permanently in status='recording'.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Wrap LiveScreen in PopScope(canPop: false) so Android back triggers a stop/confirm flow instead of abandoning the active recording. 2. Monitor BLE disconnect events and received PCM bytes during recording; display an audio-activity/warning indicator if no PCM arrives or BLE drops. 3. When stopRecording() runs with 0 audio bytes, update session state cleanly (e.g., save live transcript segments or mark failed/incomplete) rather than leaving Firestore stuck in status='recording'.

title: Persist recorded PCM/WAV to disk with retryable audio upload queue
description: SessionManager (app/lib/services/session_manager.dart:21, 203-250) buffers all decoded PCM strictly in RAM (_recordedPcmChunks) even though path_provider is already in app/pubspec.yaml. In stopRecording(), if ApiClient.uploadAudio() fails (network error, expired Firebase ID token, timeout, or 5xx), the error is silently swallowed and _recordedPcmChunks.clear() permanently destroys the audio with no retry and no user feedback. Also ApiClient._authHeaders() does not force-refresh Firebase ID tokens on 401.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Stream/flush PCM audio chunks to an on-device file under getApplicationDocumentsDirectory() during recording so audio survives process kills and crashes. 2. Finalize a local WAV file on stopRecording() and keep it on disk until POST /api/sessions/{id}/audio returns 200. 3. Add a pending-upload queue that retries failed/interrupted uploads on app startup and via a manual retry action in the UI, surfacing upload failures to the user instead of swallowing them. 4. Retry once with forceRefresh=true on HTTP 401 in ApiClient.uploadAudio().

title: Register Android ForegroundService in AndroidManifest.xml so background recordings aren't killed
description: app/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml declares FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE permissions, but does not register com.pravera.flutter_foreground_task.service.ForegroundService with android:foregroundServiceType inside <application>. In app/lib/services/session_manager.dart:146-156, FlutterForegroundTask.startService() is wrapped in an empty catch block, so failures are silently swallowed on Android 14+/Pixel 11. When the screen locks or the user switches apps, Android suspends/kills the process, dropping the live WebSocket without stopRecording() or audio upload ever running (observed in Firestore sessions sess_13aa2e4d and sess_24bf1e7d).
acceptance_criteria: 1. Declare com.pravera.flutter_foreground_task.service.ForegroundService with android:foregroundServiceType="connectedDevice|microphone" and android:exported="false" in app/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml. 2. Log/surface startService() errors in SessionManager.startRecording() instead of swallowing them. 3. Verify recording continues with screen locked / app backgrounded on Pixel without dropping audio.

title: Stop passing Firebase ID token in /api/live query string (access_token)
description: app/lib/services/gemini_live_service.dart:77-80 appends the raw Firebase ID token JWT as a query parameter (?access_token=<jwt>) on GET /api/live. As observed in Cloud Run logs for omi-pixel-service, this causes full bearer JWTs to be recorded verbatim in Google Cloud Logging HTTP request logs.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Send the Firebase ID token in the Authorization: Bearer <token> WebSocket upgrade header via IOWebSocketChannel.connect(..., headers: ...) in app/lib/services/gemini_live_service.dart. 2. Verify service/auth.go Middleware authenticates /api/live via Authorization header (and deprecate/remove query-param token logging or usage for native clients). 3. Confirm Cloud Run request logs for /api/live no longer contain JWTs.

title: Add backend fallback audio capture in LiveProxy & cleanup/delete support for orphaned recording sessions
description: On the Go Cloud Run service (service/live.go:278), LiveProxy already receives every 16kHz PCM audio chunk for session=<id> over /api/live, but discards the bytes after forwarding to Vertex AI. If the mobile client disconnects abnormally without sending POST /api/sessions/{id}/audio, all streamed audio is lost and the Firestore document remains stuck in status='recording' indefinitely (as seen on sess_13aa2e4d and sess_24bf1e7d in generative-bazaar-001/omi-pixel). service/handlers.go also has no DELETE /api/sessions/{id} endpoint to remove orphaned/failed sessions.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Evaluate and implement server-side fallback in LiveProxy: buffer streamed PCM (with a memory/size cap) or transition abandoned sessions out of 'recording' if no audio upload arrives after WebSocket close. 2. Add authenticated DELETE /api/sessions/{id} (removing Firestore doc, segments subcollection, and GCS audio if present) and expose delete in web/mobile UI. 3. Clean up orphaned Firestore sessions sess_13aa2e4d and sess_24bf1e7d.
